summary: THÉMIS tested end-to-end on the public URL. All requested desktop happy paths work: Boot/command opening, 8 tabs, client, DEV→FAC conversion, order status, stock +/- and alert, payment→invoice payé, dashboard, 3 templates, BYOK, and 10-character MYTHOS gallery. Backend targeted suite: 6/10 passed; four validation/accounting-integrity defects remain.

critical.issue: Malformed line values such as qty='bad' return HTTP 500. Backend log RCA: _totals directly calls float() on an unvalidated raw list and raises ValueError.
Accepts a payment whose doc_id references a devis (HTTP 200), although payments must target a facture; it also mutates that devis paid amount.
Deleting a full payment removes the payment row but leaves the linked invoice paid=300 and status='payé', causing invoice/payment/accounting inconsistency.

minor.issue: Whitespace-only name is accepted and persisted even though client name is mandatory; missing name is correctly rejected with 422. Test-created blank record was deleted.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking OUVRIR LE MODULE THÉMIS# closes the gallery but does not open the THÉMIS panel because App.js onOpenModule map omits THÉMIS#.
At 390x844, boot-module-themis and the entire module list are hidden, so THÉMIS cannot be opened directly from BootScreen; command opening after skipping boot still works.

issues: The due-date control uses the browser-native input type=date rather than the application's styled calendar component.

action_items: Model document lines with a Pydantic schema and numeric constraints so invalid qty/unit_price returns 422 instead of 500.
Validate that payment doc_id exists and references kind='facture'; reject quotes, unknown IDs, zero, and negative amounts.
On payment deletion, recompute the linked invoice paid total and derived status transactionally.
Trim and validate ClientIn.name with a non-empty minimum length.
Add 'THÉMIS#': setShowThemis to the MYTHOS gallery module-opening map.
Provide a reachable responsive BootScreen module list below 980px instead of display:none.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemisPanel post() ignores response.ok and response bodies, and load() silently swallows every exception; backend failures are invisible to users and forms reset as if successful.
themis_api.py uses raw list fields for document/order lines and unconstrained status/money strings; introduce typed nested models and enums before arithmetic or persistence.
Most THÉMIS interactive controls lack data-testid (quantity/price, status selectors, delete/minus buttons, payment method, item fields), reducing regression-test reliability.
ThemisPanel.jsx has one ESLint react/no-unescaped-entities error at line 85.
App.js remains a 4,347-line monolith; the newly missed THÉMIS gallery route is a concrete regression caused by duplicated module maps. Centralize module metadata/openers.

success_rate.backend: 60% targeted (6/10 passed; all requested happy paths passed, 4 validation/integrity tests failed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested desktop happy paths; 2 additional navigation/responsive defects found

seed_data_creation: Created isolated TEST_ clients, items, documents, orders, and payments; all were deleted. Final API verification found 0 TEST_ records in all five collections. Existing Restaurant Le Zeus was untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_themis.py after fixes. The four expected failures cover blank client names, malformed document lines, payment deletion reconciliation, and quote-payment rejection. Desktop E2E core flows passed. Recheck MYTHOS THÉMIS open button and mobile BootScreen at 390x844.
rca_of_the_issue: Backend validation is too permissive: ClientIn.name is an unconstrained str, DocIn.lines is a raw list followed by direct float conversion, add_payment never checks document existence/kind, and payment deletion never recalculates invoice state. Frontend gallery routing duplicates a partial module map that omits THÉMIS#. App.css explicitly applies .boot-modules { display:none } below 980px.
